claims.subject: kellan

evidence.quote: He brandishes the pair of basket hilts—Talion's parting gift.
"Besides, I got these from my lord, and they said they're just as good as any blade.

claims.summary: Kellan sets out on a quest for Talion, his fae lord, carrying Talion's basket-hilt gift.

claims.subject: talion

evidence.quote: "We witches did not create the Wicked Slumber alone. To do so would have been beyond our power."
Talion was the one who broke the stalemate. Eriette's sleeping curse, they argued, would be the surest way to counteract the invaders.

claims.summary: Hylda says the Wicked Slumber was cast by the witches together with Talion, at Talion's urging, to stop the Phyrexian invaders.
claims.limitation: Hylda's own account in dialogue; she is one of the participants.

claims.subject: wicked_slumber

evidence.quote: The Wicked Slumber might have stopped the Phyrexians in their tracks, but the Realm struck a foul bargain to pay for it.
"It was only meant to stop the invaders," she says.

claims.summary: The Wicked Slumber was meant to stop, and is said to have stopped, the Phyrexian invaders in Eldraine.
claims.limitation: Stated with hedging ('might have') and in Hylda's dialogue.

claims.subject: eriette

evidence.quote: "That it continued spiraling out of control afterward is Eriette's doing. Of that, I'm certain.
She leapt at the chance to enact a curse of that size—to have all those people at her beck and call.

claims.summary: Hylda blames Eriette for the Slumber spiraling out of control after the invasion.

claims.subject: rowan_kenrith

evidence.quote: "My name is Eriette, darling. Welcome home."
Her time with Eriette, studying the magic that would save Eldraine, had always been fated to end.
Rowan is the only person Eriette has left. At least until Ashiok returns.

claims.summary: Rowan Kenrith joins Eriette and studies her sleep magic for some weeks, believing it can save Eldraine.

claims.subject: ashiok

evidence.quote: "The spark is gone," says Ashiok, their voice a long, drawn-out hiss.
Veils of black coalesce into Ashiok's elegant form before the gathered army.
Eriette might have had trouble controlling so many at once, but for Ashiok it's second nature.

claims.summary: Ashiok is at Eriette's court and fights alongside Eriette's dreamers at the final battle.

claims.subject: rowan_kenrith

evidence.quote: Can you teach me how to planeswalk again?"
"The spark is gone," says Ashiok, their voice a long, drawn-out hiss. "For you, and for many others."

claims.summary: Rowan asks to planeswalk again; Ashiok tells her that her spark is gone.
claims.limitation: related_to records Ashiok's statement about Rowan's lost spark; Ashiok did not cause it, and this is dialogue.

claims.subject: ashiok

evidence.quote: When she opens her eyes, the jail cell stares back at her, but so, too, does Ashiok.
Darkness falls on the cell. Shackles fall to the stone ground. In the morning, when they search the cell, she will be gone.

claims.summary: After her defeat Eriette is jailed; Ashiok frees her and takes her far away.

claims.subject: oko

evidence.quote: He told me his name was Oko, and he told me that he was newly arrived in Eldraine.
The blue-streaked man on the coat's lining catches his attention anew. Oko. His father.

claims.summary: Kellan's mother tells him that his father is Oko, a fae newly arrived in Eldraine from beyond its Realms.

claims.subject: kellan

evidence.quote: It looks nothing like the portals into Talion's realm. The other side looks nothing like Eldraine.
Kellan pets Hex, and steps through the portal.

claims.summary: Kellan steps through an unfamiliar portal leading somewhere other than Eldraine, hoping to find his father.

claims.subject: ruby

evidence.quote: My brother, Peter, he knows every inch of that place like the back of his hand.

claims.summary: Ruby says Peter is her brother.

claims.subject: ruby

evidence.quote: The day is brisk and bright when Kellan and Ruby return to Edgewall.
He stands on a leaf the size of a paddock watching Kellan and Ruby climb.

claims.summary: Ruby travels with Kellan on his quest.

claims.subject: hylda

evidence.quote: "Talion has sent you to clean up the mess that all four of us created.

claims.summary: Hylda directs Kellan against Eriette's spreading curse.
claims.limitation: Hylda's dialogue; 'opposed' is an inference from her advice.

claims.subject: will_kenrith

evidence.quote: As her brother's knights burst through the gates, sparks crackle along Rowan's forearm.
"Will isn't the only one with friends," Rowan answers Imodane.

claims.summary: At the climax, Will's knights storm Eriette's castle where Rowan stands with Eriette.

remaining: Peter's and Troyan's roles are not modelled
Kellan's later arrival on other planes is out of scope here
The fate of Eriette's sleeping victims is not graded
